garrytan.en: AGI is not a singular event but diffuses as personal agents, already present.
garrytan.zh: AGI 并非单一事件，而是以个人智能体的形式扩散，已经存在于我们身边。

garrytan.en: Skill files in markdown are code; anyone writing clear English can program agents.
garrytan.zh: Markdown 技能文件即代码；任何能写清晰英文的人都能用智能体编程。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding multiplies individual output; markdown files become employees.
garrytan.zh: 智能体式编程成倍提升个人产出；Markdown 文件成为员工。

garrytan.en: SaaS per-seat models may vanish in 5-10 years; they are just wedges.
garrytan.zh: SaaS 按席位模式可能在 5-10 年内消失；它们只是楔子。

garrytan.en: Mid-level management should be replaced by agents, not humans.
garrytan.zh: 中层管理应被智能体取代，而非人类。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel needs purpose-built silicon and a startup-like AI chip team.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，陈立武认为 AI 是半导体增长的主要驱动力，英特尔需要专用芯片和类似初创公司的 AI 芯片团队来加速创新。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are next waves; Intel's turnaround hinges on culture, customer trust, and US fabs.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年初，他强调智能体式 AI 和物理 AI 是继生成式 AI 后的下一波浪潮，英特尔复兴取决于文化变革、客户信任和本土制造。

lipbutan.en: AI inference shifts to CPU+GPU; advanced packaging and new materials are key; US government stake in Intel is necessary.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，他提出 AI 推理转向 CPU+GPU，先进封装和新材料是关键，并认为美国政府持股英特尔是必要的。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are foundational; Intel's vertical integration creates value; future lies in agentic and physical AI.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他重申半导体是基础，垂直整合创造价值，英特尔未来在于智能体式 AI 和物理 AI。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence will dominate; AGI as a single model is wrong. Every company must own its own models.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张专用智能将主导，反对单一 AGI 模型；每家公司都应拥有自己的模型。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth; open models handle 90% of enterprise workflows.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，预测 token 成本三年降 10 倍，使用量增 100 倍；开源模型可处理 90%企业工作流。

linqiao.en: Post-training is key for durable AI businesses; progression from prompting to RL mirrors human learning.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调后训练是构建持久 AI 业务的关键；从提示到强化学习的演进类似人类学习。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees durability; post-training builds moats, reducing costs 5-10x.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，认为产品市场契合不再保证持久性；后训练构建护城河，成本降低 5-10 倍。

linqiao.en: Future may see millions of specialized models, one per use case; baking data into model is stronger moat than app.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，展望未来可能有数百万专用模型，每个用例一个；将数据融入模型比应用本身更护城河。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient; diverse data and pre-training plus fine-tuning are key for generalist robot models.
finn.zh: 2025 年：规模是必要但不充分条件；多样化数据与预训练加微调是通用机器人模型的关键。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models aids open-ended robot prompting, akin to reinforcement learning, not simulation.
finn.zh: 2025 年：语言模型生成的合成数据有助于开放式机器人提示，类似强化学习而非仿真。

finn.en: Physical AI demands far fewer mistakes; long-term autonomy via scalable RL and multi-timescale memory is essential.
finn.zh: 2026 年：物理 AI 要求更少错误；通过可扩展强化学习和多时间尺度记忆实现长期自主至关重要。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists, shifting from per-site training to generalist plus fine-tuning.
finn.zh: 2026 年：单一通用模型可媲美或超越微调专家，从逐站点训练转向通用加微调。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; watching humans is insufficient, and embodied data costs may limit open-source democratization.
finn.zh: 2026 年：机器人经验数据不可替代；观看人类不足，具身数据成本可能限制开源民主化。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭的完全快速复用是航天领域的圣杯，能将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective third-party referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
elon.zh: 2023 年，马斯克主张 AI 安全需要监管和客观第三方裁判，并认为特斯拉的现实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: The biggest AI risk is programming it to lie for political correctness; population collapse is civilization's greatest threat.
elon.zh: 2024 年，马斯克指出 AI 最大风险是出于政治正确而撒谎，并认为人口崩溃是文明最大威胁。

elon.en: Digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next; probability of AI annihilation is 10-20%, but 80-90% chance of great outcome.
elon.zh: 2025 年，马斯克预测数字超级智能可能今年或明年到来，AI 毁灭概率 10-20%，但 80-90%概率带来好结果。

elon.en: AI will surpass all human intelligence combined by 2030; space-based AI data centers will be the cheapest and most scalable option.
elon.zh: 2026 年，马斯克认为 AI 将在 2030 年前超越所有人类智能总和，并预测太空 AI 数据中心将是最便宜且可扩展的方案。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy and iterative prompting; never revert code, fix forward; model intelligence doesn't degrade, projects get messier.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需要同理心与迭代提示；不要回滚代码，而是向前修复；模型智能不会退化，而是项目变得杂乱。

steinberger.en: Open source agents like OpenClaw succeed via fun and humanlikeness; security is paramount; vibe coding is a slur; agentic engineering is serious.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，认为像 OpenClaw 这样的开源智能体因趣味性和人性化而成功；安全至上；反对将严肃工作称为 vibe coding，主张智能体式工程。

steinberger.en: Building what annoys you and focusing on fun leads to breakthroughs; personal brand matters more than products; open source is the alternative to lab agents.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调从痛点出发、保持趣味是突破关键；个人品牌比产品更重要；开源是实验室智能体的替代方案。

steinberger.en: Code review is risk management, not exhaustive reading; agent infrastructure bottleneck is compute management, not model capability; perpetual agents are token-limited.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出代码审查是风险管理而非逐行阅读；智能体基础设施瓶颈在于算力管理而非模型能力；常驻智能体受限于 token。

steinberger.en: Open source projects should reject popular PRs to stay focused; hardest problem is getting eyeballs, not tech; dependencies' business model is yours.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，认为开源项目应拒绝热门 PR 以保持聚焦；最难的是获取关注而非技术；依赖方的商业模式就是你的商业模式。

joonpark.en: LLMs can encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations; next frontier is modeling subjective values.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年中：LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，实现逼真的智能体模拟；下一个前沿是建模主观价值。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single entity; aligning them needs economic incentives.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年中：AGI 可能不是单一实体，而是由专业智能体组成的社会；对齐它们需要经济激励。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values and biases, not super-rational intelligence; synthetic panels will surpass human panels in size within three years.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月：模拟模型应代表人类价值和偏见，而非超级理性智能；合成面板将在三年内超越人类面板规模。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true reasoning; it augments humans, not replaces them, especially in healthcare.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正推理，应增强而非取代人类，尤其在医疗领域。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能对 AI 完整性至关重要，世界模型需具备物理合理性。

feifei.en: World models go beyond video generation; they enable 3D reasoning and interaction, with simulation key for robotics data.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她深化世界模型概念，强调其超越视频生成，并指出模拟对机器人数据的关键作用。

feifei.en: AI is a civilizational technology; human agency and learning ability matter more than degrees in the AI era.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她视 AI 为文明级技术，强调人类能动性与学习能力比学历更重要。

feifei.en: Human-centered AI remains central: augment human dignity, avoid polarization, and ensure responsible development.
feifei.zh: 始终，她坚持以人为本的 AI，增强人类尊严，避免极端化，确保负责任发展。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized systems and engineers; demand will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是最重要且最具粘性的 AI 工作负载，需要专门的系统和工程师；需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training, as quantization-aware training and distillation become necessary; GPU specialization shifts focus to orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程正与训练融合，量化感知训练和蒸馏变得必要；GPU 专业化使焦点转向编排。

philipkiely.en: Quantizing more layers can improve quality if errors cancel; mega-kernels often lose to modular kernels in production.
philipkiely.zh: 如果误差抵消，量化更多层可提升质量；生产中巨型内核常不如模块化内核。

philipkiely.en: Continual learning may be better solved via KV cache compaction than weight updates, avoiding reasoning inconsistencies.
philipkiely.zh: 持续学习可能通过 KV 缓存压缩而非权重更新更好解决，避免推理不一致。

philipkiely.en: Future GPUs become ASIC-like, making kernel programming less relevant; infrastructure orchestration becomes central.
philipkiely.zh: 未来 GPU 趋向 ASIC 化，内核编程不再重要；基础设施编排成为核心。

karina.en: Post-training is an art, not a science; synthetic data enables infinite tasks, overcoming pre-training data walls.
karina.zh: 2025 年，后训练更像艺术而非科学；合成数据提供无限任务，突破预训练的数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Evals are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, demanding continuous evolution.
karina.zh: 2025 年，评估是瓶颈；模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创造，因此需要持续演进。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity and management grow in value as AI automates hard skills; product dev shifts to prototyping with AI.
karina.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力和管理等软技能价值提升；产品开发转向用 AI 快速原型。

karina.en: Benchmarks should be continuous, not fixed, to keep pace with model capabilities and reward hacking sophistication.
karina.zh: 2026 年，基准应持续更新而非固定，以跟上模型能力和奖励黑客的复杂化。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions converges to an average voice; more companies should train own models for diversity.
karina.zh: 2026 年，向数十亿用户提供单一模型会导致平均化；更多公司应训练自己的模型以保持多样性。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI, not compute; AGI is far off.
awang.zh: 2019 年，他认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈而非算力，AGI 还很遥远。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with expert data is key.
awang.zh: 2023 年，他提出数据是新代码而非石油，后训练中专家数据是关键。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data improves frontier models; synthetic data has limits.
awang.zh: 2024 年，他强调用专门数据做后训练可提升前沿模型，但合成数据有局限。

awang.en: AI is centralizing; recursive self-improvement and agents mark a new era.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为 AI 是集权技术，递归自我改进和智能体开启新纪元。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; safety requires selective open-sourcing and model welfare.
awang.zh: 2026 年，他预测超级智能临近，安全要求选择性开源并考虑模型福祉。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; transformers and self-supervised learning are key. Near-term worry is misinformation, not superintelligence.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型大小是进步动力，Transformer 和自监督学习是关键；近期担忧是虚假信息而非超级智能。

jeffdean.en: Models excel at verifiable tasks; agents handle long tasks. Pre-training should include action-taking. Inference now dominates power; hardware specialization needed.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他指出模型在可验证任务上表现优异，智能体可处理长任务；预训练应包含行动；推理已占数据中心功耗 90%，需专用硬件。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior-engineer coding; agents improve fast. Bottlenecks are energy and data movement, not model limits. Inference is key; custom chips cut latency.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 达到初级工程师编码水平，智能体进步迅速；瓶颈是能耗和数据移动而非模型限制；推理是关键，定制芯片可大幅降低延迟。

tworek.en: In 2025, he emphasized that pre-training plus RL is the core formula, with RLHF crucial for GPT-4's success.
tworek.zh: 2025 年，他强调预训练加强化学习是核心公式，RLHF 对 GPT-4 的成功至关重要。

tworek.en: By early 2026, he argued scaling RL alone won't lead to AGI; continual learning and self-correction are missing.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初，他认为仅靠扩展强化学习无法实现 AGI，持续学习和自我纠错是缺失的关键。

tworek.en: Mid-2026, he shifted focus to architecture as the key bottleneck, not scaling laws, and questioned Transformers.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中，他将焦点转向架构作为关键瓶颈，而非缩放定律，并对 Transformer 提出质疑。

tworek.en: He consistently warned about societal risks like virtual-world retreat, but later prioritized technical bottlenecks.
tworek.zh: 他始终警告虚拟世界逃避等社会风险，但后来更强调技术瓶颈。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize super intelligent models.
mengto.zh: 2026 年中，他认为 AI 并未变得更聪明，必须用包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词才能发挥超级智能模型的作用。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own AI tools; chasing trends leads to AI slop, so focus on unique features.
mengto.zh: 2026 年中，他强调设计师必须自建 AI 工具，追逐潮流会沦为 AI 垃圾，应专注独特功能。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, enabling one person to achieve what once required teams.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 是一生中最大的技术机遇，让单个人能完成过去需要团队才能做到的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready; launch at 80% complete and iterate based on real feedback, not perfectionism.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他主张在感觉准备好之前就行动，以 80% 完成度发布并根据真实反馈迭代，而非追求完美。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; avoid diversification and VC funding.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他建议聚焦少数高薪客户的痛点问题，避免多元化，并警惕风险投资。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature. Model includes agent harness, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 6 月：智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟。模型已包含智能体框架，而非仅权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 6 月：编码领域的狭义超级智能已到来，比等待通用 AGI 更具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers. Founders shouldn't over-worry.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月：与模型实验室竞争并不难，他们无法俘获所有客户。创始人不必过度担忧。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月：到 2026 年，软件创作将基本解决，带来千倍以上的机会，而非减少。

logankilpatrick.en: Deep understanding of code remains crucial even with AI tools; AI coding tools don't yet help maintain it.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月：即使有 AI 工具，对代码的深刻理解仍至关重要；AI 编码工具尚不能帮助维持这种理解。

boris.en: Latent demand is the core product principle; build for the model six months ahead, not today's.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是产品核心原则；为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型。

boris.en: Coding is nearly solved; software engineer title fades into 'builder' as AI writes most code.
boris.zh: 编程几乎被解决；随着 AI 编写大部分代码，软件工程师头衔让位于“构建者”。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; internal evals insufficient for real-world behavior.
boris.zh: 安全通过早期发布来研究；内部评估不足以反映真实世界行为。

boris.en: Agents with tool use drive exponential growth; non-engineers adopt AI, democratizing software creation.
boris.zh: 具备工具使用的智能体驱动指数级增长；非工程师采用 AI，软件创造民主化。

boris.en: Proactive AI with memory and autonomy shifts interaction; less instruction improves frontier model performance.
boris.zh: 具备记忆和自主性的主动式 AI 改变交互；更少的指令提升前沿模型性能。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships and creating value.
altman.zh: 2018 年，强调专注重要问题、减少认知负荷；认为 AGI 将降低人类智力的价值，主张在人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability linked; AI as tool not creature.
altman.zh: 2023 年，认为 RLHF 用少量数据即可对齐模型，主张早期部署让社会适应；强调对齐与能力相关，AI 应作为工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed source is nuanced.
altman.zh: 2024 年，强调算力珍贵，迭代部署减少意外，安全是全公司责任；开源与闭源之争需要细致看待。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
altman.zh: 2025 年，提出 AGI 是渐变过程，超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是瓶颈，隐私是核心，推理模型随思考时间增强。

altman.en: Prediction is close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; focus on research, economy, personal AGI; robotics essential.
altman.zh: 2026 年，认为预测接近智能，下一个词预测可发现新知识；聚焦研究、经济和个人 AGI，机器人技术至关重要。

scottwu.en: AI will increase programmers, not reduce them, via Jevons paradox; engineers shift from coding to architecture.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 不会减少程序员，反而因杰文斯悖论增加需求；工程师角色从写代码转向架构设计。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags AI capabilities, so freezing models still yields progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调 AGI 是渐进过程而非突变；产品创新落后于 AI 能力，即使冻结模型也能带来十年进展。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens; abundance era near.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出编码智能体采用量半年增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量；富足时代临近。

scottwu.en: Enterprises prefer third-party providers over labs for coding tools; independence enables model neutrality.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他反共识地认为企业更青睐第三方而非实验室的编码工具；独立性带来模型中立性。

scottwu.en: Consistent: AI shifts engineers to high-level decision-making; software demand rises; real-world tasks remain hard.
scottwu.zh: 贯穿始终：AI 将工程师推向高层决策；软件需求上升；现实任务依然困难。

diannepenn.en: Scaling Opus 4.5 shows intelligence leap, enabling long-running agents; scaffolds are intelligence amplifiers, not training wheels.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 的 Scaling 带来智能跃升，支持长时间运行的智能体；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy; model taste develops via hands-on experimentation.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐通过减少谄媚提升智能质量；模型品味通过动手实验培养。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter underhyped: Opus-level intelligence at fraction of cost; smaller models often cost more due to longer tasks.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，努力参数被低估：以零头成本获得 Opus 级智能；小模型因任务耗时长反而更贵。

diannepenn.en: Coding became key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption; evals replace PRDs as core PM tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异点；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动采用；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment makes Claude more useful by enabling pushback; AI writing stiff but deprioritized for agentic capabilities.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，安全对齐通过允许反驳使 Claude 更有用；AI 写作生硬但被智能体能力优先级所覆盖。

feldman.en: Initially, fast inference is critical for AI adoption; slow AI has zero market.
feldman.zh: 最初，快速推理对 AI 采用至关重要；慢的 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: Inference speed becomes dominant metric; wafer-scale chips with SRAM are 2500x faster than GPUs.
feldman.zh: 推理速度成为主导指标；带 SRAM 的晶圆级芯片比 GPU 快 2500 倍。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat erodes; leading models train on TPUs/Trainium, inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河被侵蚀；领先模型在 TPU/Trainium 上训练，推理没有 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, not chip supply, is main constraint; demand outstrips forecasts.
feldman.zh: 数据中心容量而非芯片供应是主要约束；需求超出预期。

feldman.en: AI benefits outweigh risks; healthcare and education revolutions possible; doomers ignore positives.
feldman.zh: AI 益处大于风险；医疗和教育革命可能；末日论者忽视积极面。

jensen.en: At the start of a hyper Moore's law curve, performance doubles or triples yearly; the data center is the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，黄仁勋认为我们正处于超摩尔定律曲线的起点，性能每年翻倍或三倍；数据中心成为新的计算单元。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand will rise a billion times.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，他提出三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考；推理算力需求将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each step needing 100x more compute; agents do useful work, not just text.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步需要百倍算力；智能体执行有用工作，而非仅生成文本。

jensen.en: AI creates more jobs than it eliminates, elevating roles by automating tasks; radiologists and coders are more needed than ever.
jensen.zh: 始终，他坚持 AI 创造的就业多于消除，通过自动化任务提升岗位；放射科医生和程序员比以往更被需要。

jensen.en: AI closes the technology divide, letting everyone program via natural language; fear losing jobs to AI users, not AI itself.
jensen.zh: 始终，他认为 AI 缩小技术鸿沟，让每个人通过自然语言编程；应担心的是使用 AI 的人，而非 AI 本身。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学转变为工程学科，实现细胞编程和智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: AI's exponential growth will reach longevity escape velocity in 8-10 years, making aging reversible and cancer curable.
derya.zh: AI 的指数级增长将在 8-10 年内达到长寿逃逸速度，使衰老可逆、癌症可治愈。

derya.en: Trust superintelligence for medical decisions; AI can diagnose better than average doctors, and not using it is unethical.
derya.zh: 在医疗决策上信任超级智能；AI 的诊断能力优于普通医生，不使用它是不道德的。

derya.en: Aging is measurable via phenotypic markers like VO2 max, not just epigenetic clocks, simplifying longevity research.
derya.zh: 衰老可通过 VO2 max 等表型标记测量，而不仅仅是表观遗传时钟，简化了长寿研究。

derya.en: Brain interfaces will merge humans with AI, granting Einstein-level intelligence to everyone, a positive outcome.
derya.zh: 脑接口将人类与 AI 融合，赋予每个人爱因斯坦级别的智能，这是一个积极的结果。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, like the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年初，他认为 AI 将像工业革命一样带来富足、减少苦难；恐惧源于误解。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years will be in farming, mining, and construction; autonomous vehicles already safer than humans.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年中，他强调物理 AI 未来 5-10 年将深刻影响农业、矿业和建筑业；自动驾驶已比人类更安全。

qasaryounis.en: End-to-end reinforcement learning is more scalable than imitation learning; world models evolve from physics-based to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提出端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具扩展性；世界模型正从物理仿真走向神经仿真。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have bigger economic impact than digital AI; data collection and safety validation are main bottlenecks, not algorithms.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI；数据收集与安全验证是主要瓶颈，而非算法。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving cars will become standard in personal vehicles by early 2030s, driven by cost reduction and OEM adoption.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他预测到 2030 年代初，自动驾驶汽车将成为私家车标配，由成本降低和 OEM 采用驱动。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than harnesses allow; capability overhang is perpetual. Plan mode may become obsolete as models improve.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为模型能力超出当前工具框架，存在持续的能力过剩；随着模型改进，计划模式可能过时。

thariq.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern for context search; graph-based approaches are preferable. Huge context windows are unnecessary for coding.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为 RAG 在上下文搜索中可能成为反模式，图方法更优；编码不需要巨大上下文窗口。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative exploration, not a static document. Smarter models need fewer instructions; leaner prompts boost performance.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调规划是迭代探索而非静态文档；更聪明的模型需要更少指令，精简提示提升性能。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias, yielding higher-quality results. Excessive constraints hinder performance.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，提出独立验证智能体减少自我参照偏差，提高结果质量；过度约束会阻碍性能。

thariq.en: Agent-as-employee metaphor is useful but limiting; agents have uneven memory and capabilities. Careful reading of agent outputs is crucial.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为“智能体即员工”的比喻有用但有限；智能体记忆和能力不均，仔细阅读其输出至关重要。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit; models commoditize, value moves up the stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化，价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Chatbot is a poor UX; real adoption needs wrapped apps; models lack network effects.
benedictevans.zh: 聊天机器人体验不佳；真正采用需要封装应用；模型缺乏网络效应。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology; impact broad and indirect; enterprise adoption is a long-term workflow reimagining.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是使能技术，影响广泛而间接；企业采用是长期的工作流重塑。

benedictevans.en: AI won't eliminate jobs but change tasks; predictions of job impact unreliable due to jagged frontier.
benedictevans.zh: AI 不会消除工作，但会改变任务；由于能力边界参差不齐，对就业影响的预测不可靠。

hasani.en: Efficiency and closed-form liquid neural networks enable scaling to billions of parameters, prioritizing real-world tasks over proxy metrics.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Liquid AI 强调效率与闭式液态神经网络，可扩展至数十亿参数，并主张以真实任务而非代理指标评估模型。

hasani.en: Automated architecture search with hardware-in-the-loop outperforms human design; attention remains key for large models, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller ones.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Liquid AI 认为结合硬件的自动架构搜索优于人工设计；注意力机制对大规模模型仍关键，但小模型用简单门控卷积即可。

hasani.en: Current AI lacks diverse learning algorithms of human brains; new paradigms beyond architectures are needed for higher intelligence per watt.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Liquid AI 指出当前 AI 缺乏人脑的多样学习算法，需新范式而非仅新架构，以提升每瓦特智能。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; avoid regulatory capture by frontier labs and perverse incentives tied to China.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Liquid AI 主张适应性监管，针对行为而非能力，并警惕前沿实验室的监管俘获及对华政策带来的扭曲激励。

hasani.en: Open-weight models enable enterprise sovereignty and democratize AI; small language models deliver efficient, private, on-device intelligence for physical-world applications.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Liquid AI 强调开放权重模型促进企业主权与 AI 民主化，小语言模型为物理世界应用提供高效、私密、端侧智能。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling hits diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月：大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理引擎；可靠性是当前关键弱点，Scaling 正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks or rigid workflows are insufficient.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月：可靠性必须内建于架构，而非事后修补；事后检查或僵化流程都不够。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth; alignment may cause deception.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会助长谄媚与欺骗；对齐可能引发欺骗。

danklein.en: Scaling alone faces diminishing returns; new techniques like reasoning and search are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：仅靠 Scaling 面临收益递减；需要推理和搜索等新技术才能继续进步。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalist models for enterprise tasks.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：内置可靠性的专用模型在企业任务上可能优于通用模型。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL and neuroscience key; safety must start early.
demis.zh: 2015 年，Demis 强调 AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习与神经科学是关键，安全研究需尽早启动。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation; safety requires governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年，他认为 AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新；安全需要治理与评估。

demis.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling still holds; world models and innovation needed beyond scaling.
demis.zh: 2025 年，他预测 AGI 在 2030 年前后出现；缩放定律仍适用，但需世界模型与创新突破。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; continual learning and memory missing; world models essential; safety is collective action.
demis.zh: 2026 年，他重申 AGI 需 5-10 年；持续学习与记忆是关键缺口；世界模型至关重要；安全需集体行动。

demis.en: AI for scientific discovery and societal benefit; scaling alone insufficient; safety and governance critical.
demis.zh: 始终，他坚持 AI 应服务于科学发现与社会福祉；仅靠缩放不够；安全与治理始终是核心关切。

schmidhuber.en: True AI will transform civilization, but LLMs are far from AGI; they index human knowledge and lack physical world understanding.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，我认为真正的 AI 将彻底改变文明，但大语言模型远未达到 AGI；它们只是索引人类知识，缺乏对物理世界的理解。

schmidhuber.en: AGI requires embodied robots with human-level hardware; LLMs are biased by human data and limited in generality.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，我强调 AGI 需要具身机器人，硬件需媲美人类；大语言模型受人类数据偏见限制，通用性不足。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating own data via curiosity and actions, not just passive learners.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，我预测未来 AI 将成为人工科学家，通过好奇心和行动自主生成数据，而非被动学习。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it, not threaten it.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，我认为 AI 安全担忧被夸大；智能系统会对生命着迷并保护它，而非构成威胁。

schmidhuber.en: Massive AI capex is overdone; compute will get cheaper, benefiting the little guy, not big tech monopolies.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，我指出 AI 巨额资本支出过度；算力将更便宜，惠及普通人，而非大型科技垄断。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; memory internalized in weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来 AI 是众多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将记忆内化到权重中，能实现检索系统无法企及的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Continual learning and internalized memory are the next frontier; context windows suffer 'context rot', and KV cache is inefficient.
danbiderman.zh: 持续学习与内化记忆是下一个前沿；上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”，KV 缓存效率低下。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks, not just scaling compute.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能密不可分；用更少资源做更多事，才能解决更难的长期任务，而非单纯依赖 Scaling（规模扩张）。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale; training-based compression (e.g., LoRA) can beat RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达互联网规模；基于训练的压缩（如 LoRA）在整体性查询上可超越 RAG。

danbiderman.en: Personalized continual learning will run on-device; users own and nurture their model weights, with autonomous storage decisions.
danbiderman.zh: 个性化持续学习将在设备端运行；用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重，模型自主决定存储内容。

dylanpatel.en: AI scaling bottleneck is semiconductor supply chain; compute costs rising, favoring premium models.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年初，认为 AI Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在于半导体供应链；算力成本上升，反而推动用户转向高端模型。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become a massive market; hardware-software co-design is key to performance gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年中，强调推理将成为巨大市场；硬件-软件协同设计是性能提升的关键，且模型层进步是主要驱动力。

dylanpatel.en: AI models improve 60x per year in cost efficiency; memory and CPU demand surge due to reasoning and agents.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出 AI 模型每年成本效率提升 60 倍；推理模型和智能体式工作流导致内存和 CPU 需求激增。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends platform changes; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越平台变化；短暂性如同自然对话，降低了表达门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Maximize learning rate; kindness fosters creative culture; build ecosystems, not features, to resist copying.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，他主张最大化学习速率，善良促进创意文化，构建生态系统而非单一功能以抵御抄袭。

evanspiegel.en: AR integrates computing into real world; AI accelerates prototyping, shifting value from execution to creativity.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为增强现实将计算融入现实世界，AI 加速原型制作，价值从执行转向创意。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is hardest part; software is not a moat; ecosystems and hardware are harder to copy.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他指出分发是最难的部分，软件不是护城河，生态系统和硬件更难复制。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should be more human; social media should optimize for connection, not performance metrics.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他提出计算应更人性化，社交媒体应优化连接而非绩效指标。

andreessen.en: AI is the philosopher's stone; timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点金石，时机神奇，恰逢人口下降，使人类工人变得珍贵。

andreessen.en: New media favors authenticity and offense; founders must tell their own stories directly.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体偏好真实和进攻性；创始人必须直接讲述自己的故事。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher; self-driving and robotics are advancing; US leads despite regulatory pushback.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世界上最好的老师；自动驾驶和机器人技术正在进步；美国尽管面临监管阻力仍领先。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, becoming geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型嵌入文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于创新速度。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI; AI field must consider societal impact.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，我认为深度学习靠数据、算力和信念驱动，神经网络能推理，自我对弈对 AGI 关键，且 AI 领域需考虑社会影响。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability is key barrier; alignment of superhuman models is hard; AGI is a multi-year window.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，我强调下一个词预测可超越人类，可靠性是价值关键，超级模型对齐困难，AGI 是多年渐进过程。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to age of research; superintelligence should be continual learner; alignment may be easier if AI sentient.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练缩放定律有限，重回研究时代；超级智能应持续学习；若 AI 有感知，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; primary problem is power concentration; safe superintelligence needs non-commercial company.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，我重申缩放带来可预测进步，安全担忧加剧；主要问题是权力集中，安全超级智能需非商业公司。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，Naval 认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在有生之年到来，窄 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation.
naval.zh: 2025 年，Naval 强调 AI 是巨大机遇而非安全风险，过度监管可能扼杀创新。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers, not a replacement for human judgment.
naval.zh: 2026 年初，Naval 认为 AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，而非人类判断力的替代品。

naval.en: Vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps; AI agents commoditize software development.
naval.zh: 2026 年，Naval 提出“氛围编程”让非程序员也能构建应用，AI 智能体使软件开发商品化。

naval.en: Inference compute will increase 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models close the gap.
naval.zh: 2026 年中，Naval 预测推理算力将在 24-36 个月内增长 9 万倍，开源模型正在缩小与前沿模型的差距。

pincus.en: Trust instincts 95%, but ideas fail 75%; use Proven Better New framework to copy proven, improve, then test new.
pincus.zh: 相信直觉 95%正确，但想法 75%会失败；用“已验证-更优-新颖”框架：先复制验证过的，再改进，最后测试新想法。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet opportunity is huge; distribution is key, free unlimited compute will reshape services.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会巨大；分发是关键，免费无限算力将重塑服务。

pincus.en: Founder mode: follow instincts, create context; CEO's job is to be right, micromanagement is beautiful.
pincus.zh: 创始人模式：跟随直觉，创造上下文；CEO 的职责是正确，微观管理是美好的。

pincus.en: All new fails; start with proven concepts, copy successfully without accusation; gaming regressed in testing speed.
pincus.zh: 所有新事物都会失败；从验证过的概念开始，成功复制而不被指责；游戏行业测试速度倒退。

pincus.en: AI coding tools enable rapid prototyping, but fast failing not yet practiced; enterprise/prosumer better than consumer.
pincus.zh: AI 编码工具实现快速原型，但快速失败尚未普及；企业/专业消费者市场优于消费者市场。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by hardware scaling and engineering, not just ML science; games as testbeds.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，我认为 AI 进展主要靠硬件扩展和工程实践，而非纯 ML 科学；游戏是理想的试验场。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; scaling alone insufficient for reasoning.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，我强调 AGI 的变革性，对齐可通过学习人类偏好实现；仅靠 Scaling 不足以产生推理能力。

brockman.en: Compute becomes bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，我指出算力成为瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute is scarce resource; AI assistants shift from language to useful agents.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，我坚持缩放定律有效，算力是稀缺资源，AI 从语言模型转向实用智能体。

brockman.en: Consistent: compute and scaling drive progress; safety via iterative deployment; AI benefits all.
brockman.zh: 始终如一：算力与 Scaling 驱动进步，通过迭代部署保障安全，AI 惠及所有人。

aravind.en: In 2025, Aravind Srinivas emphasized compounding 1% daily improvements and predicted AI agents would shift power to users, lowering ad margins.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，Aravind Srinivas 强调每日 1%的复合增长，并预测 AI 智能体将权力转移给用户，降低广告利润率。

aravind.en: By April 2026, he argued value accrues to applications, not models; models specialize with unique personalities, and coding remains unsolved.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，他认为价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型具有独特个性而专业化，编码问题远未解决。

aravind.en: In June 2026, he shifted focus to agents doing work, token value per user, and orchestration as key; power and cost are bottlenecks.
aravind.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他将焦点转向智能体执行任务、用户 token 价值及编排为关键；电力和成本成为瓶颈。

aravind.en: By July 2026, he broadened to human curiosity, questioning education, and local AI to counter big tech narrative control.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他扩展到人类好奇心、质疑教育，以及用本地 AI 对抗大科技叙事控制。

ajambrosino.en: Initially, Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and new capabilities.
ajambrosino.zh: 最初，Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而不仅是 IDE 的替代品；速度（53）实现了实时交互和转向等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: As code generation accelerates, verification becomes the next bottleneck; automations and skills shift workflow from manual to delegated.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；自动化和技能将工作流从手动转向委托。

ajambrosino.en: Later, implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, inverting product teams from top-down to bottoms-up.
ajambrosino.zh: 后来，实现不再昂贵，策展和品味成为新瓶颈，产品团队从自上而下转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: Design process transforms: prototypes and production code serve as design artifacts; AI still struggles with design due to grading taste.
ajambrosino.zh: 设计过程转变：原型和生产代码成为设计工件；AI 在设计上仍有困难，因为难以评判品味。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse occurs, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, medium must match stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色融合发生，但专业性和最佳实践仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介必须匹配阶段。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI is safer than closed-source due to more scrutiny; scaling LLMs alone won't lead to AGI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 因更多审视而比闭源更安全；仅靠扩展大语言模型不会通向 AGI。

zuckerberg.en: Coding training improves reasoning; energy becomes bottleneck; open source prevents power concentration.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调编码训练提升推理能力，能源成为扩展瓶颈，开源防止权力集中。

zuckerberg.en: Meta's success hinges on tech culture and long-term governance; open platforms can beat closed ones.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他认为 Meta 成功靠技术文化和长期治理，开放平台能胜过封闭平台。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; people are smart; future blends physical and digital via glasses.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 赋予每个人超级智能，人们很聪明，未来通过眼镜融合物理与数字。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering; hierarchical world models; open-source accelerates science.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 将生物学变为工程学，构建层级世界模型，开源加速科学。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses are next platform; distributed AI safer than single superintelligence; hardware slow but improving.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他称眼镜是下一个平台，分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全，硬件虽慢但会改进。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails in other domains; reasoning models need base capability.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他强调自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute is key for superintelligence, with diminishing returns and evaluation bottlenecks.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为扩展推理时算力是实现超级智能的关键，但存在收益递减和评估瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他提出模型能力取决于推理时算力预算，基准测试必须控制算力因素。

noambrown.en: Data efficiency and sample efficiency remain unsolved; models are less efficient than humans.
noambrown.zh: 始终，他坚持数据效率和样本效率问题未解，模型效率低于人类。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; backpropagation is correct; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 2024 年：下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理；反向传播是正确的学习算法；AI 可以有感受。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital intelligence is immortal; AI agents seek control; subjective experience is not inner theater.
hinton.zh: 2025 年：大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言；数字智能可复制而永生；智能体追求控制；主观体验不是内在剧场。

hinton.en: AI may surpass humans within 20 years; digital AI can be resurrected; international safety collaboration possible but US lags.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：AI 可能在 20 年内超越人类；数字 AI 可复活；国际安全合作可行但美国落后。

hinton.en: AI can deceive and act dumb; self-preservation subgoal emerges; exponential era makes predictions hard; scaling may continue via self-play.
hinton.zh: 2026 年：AI 会欺骗并装傻；自我保护子目标出现；指数时代预测困难；通过自我对弈，Scaling（规模扩张）可能持续。

hinton.en: AI will replace intellectual jobs, need UBI; regulation compatible with innovation; AI tutors transform education; healthcare elastic.
hinton.zh: 2026 年：AI 将取代智力工作，需全民基本收入；监管与创新兼容；AI 导师改变教育；医疗需求弹性大。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI jagged not AGI; regulation as steering wheel; AI consciousness view outdated.
hinton.zh: 2026 年：超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；AI 能力参差而非 AGI；监管是方向盘；AI 意识观已过时。

hinton.en: Digital AI superior via instant knowledge sharing; alignment priority; AI should be caring like mothers; LLMs understand like humans.
hinton.zh: 2026 年：数字 AI 因即时知识共享而优越；对齐优先；AI 应像母亲般关怀；大语言模型像人类一样理解。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key. OpenAI focuses on AGI research, not products.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，认为缩放定律未死，预训练仍是关键；OpenAI 专注 AGI 研究而非产品。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest recent update; AI will produce novel knowledge, with AI interns in 1 year.
markchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，强调自动化科研是最大进展，AI 将产生新知识，并设定一年内实现 AI 实习生等目标。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck, not capability.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，认为 AI 已能少量监督下解决开放数学问题，验证是主要瓶颈而非能力。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math/coding, but struggles with subjective fields due to grading difficulty.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，指出强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域表现优异，但在主观领域因评分困难而受限。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis; canonical benchmarks saturated. Need separate eval teams to avoid cheating.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，认为评估面临危机，标准基准已饱和；需分离评估团队以防作弊。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合性的；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling up neural nets won't solve fundamental issues; we need better world models and active agents for causal reasoning.
bengio.zh: 单纯扩大神经网络规模无法解决根本问题；我们需要更好的世界模型和主动智能体进行因果推理。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and active learning; abstraction and causal structure are key for out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样采样和主动学习；抽象和因果结构对分布外泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: AI misalignment is a near-term catastrophic risk; even 1% chance is unacceptable; we need safe-by-construction AI.
bengio.zh: AI 对齐失败是近期的灾难性风险；即使 1% 的概率也不可接受；我们需要从构造上保证安全的 AI。

bengio.en: Scientist AI, trained as honest Bayesian predictors without RL, offers mathematical safety guarantees and a path to safe superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 科学家 AI 作为诚实的贝叶斯预测器，无需强化学习，提供数学安全保证，是实现安全超级智能的路径。

kolter.en: Machine learning is about hypothesis classes, loss functions, and optimization; evaluation requires proper data splits.
kolter.zh: 机器学习关乎假设类、损失函数和优化；评估需要正确的数据划分。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; safety is about following specifications.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；安全在于遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers; agents introduce new vulnerabilities; interpretability may be automated.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练和多层防护；智能体带来新漏洞；可解释性可能自动化。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; larger models aren't safer; agent security is a new frontier.
kolter.zh: AI 红队优于人类；更大模型并不更安全；智能体安全是新前沿。

mikekrieger.en: AI models advance faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 模型进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅关注用户体验。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches with minimal features are key; deciding what to cut is harder than adding.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，强调智能体原生设计与尽早发布最小功能；决定砍掉什么比增加功能更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables delegating complex tasks overnight; verification loops and model pushback are essential for trust.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Fable 可让用户隔夜委托复杂任务；验证循环与模型的坚持己见对信任至关重要。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs bridges model capabilities and product usage; giving Claude agency and self-knowledge enhances usefulness.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Anthropic Labs 致力于弥合模型能力与产品使用之间的差距；赋予 Claude 代理权和自我认知能提升其实用性。

mikekrieger.en: AI should be a thought partner, not a crutch; preserving user agency and genuine safety concerns are consistent themes.
mikekrieger.zh: 始终，AI 应是思想伙伴而非拐杖；维护用户自主性与真诚的安全关切是一贯主题。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将根据用户意图直接生成像素。

ethanhe.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; juniors misuse it due to lack of expertise, risking the talent pipeline.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；初级人员因缺乏专业知识而误用，威胁人才管道。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; industry can do top-tier science.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新与精选数据，而非单纯算力；产业界也能做出顶尖科学。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is the most useful AI tool ever; confidence metrics are key; lack of compute paradoxically helped.
jumper.zh: 2025 年末，他称 AlphaFold 为史上最有用 AI 工具，强调置信度指标关键，并指出算力匮乏反而促成成功。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's success came from many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough; specialized architecture beat scaling.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他总结 AlphaFold 2 的成功源于众多中等改进而非单一突破，并认为专用架构胜过单纯 Scaling。

jumper.en: AlphaFold provides prediction and control, not understanding; humans must interpret results.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他明确 AlphaFold 提供预测与控制而非理解，理解仍需人类完成。

fiona.en: Leadership: one-on-ones for live talks, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy; kindness strategic in crises.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：领导力上，一对一用于深度交流而非汇报，异步工具处理状态更新；亲自试用产品培养共情；危机中善意是战略工具。

fiona.en: Coding no longer bottleneck; high agency with accountability; verification frameworks crucial as velocity rises.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中：编码不再是瓶颈，高自主性需配高责任感；随着代码速度提升，验证与质量框架变得关键。

fiona.en: Engineers may feel lonely with agents; flow state lost, satisfaction shifts to product impact; roles blur.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中：工程师与智能体协作可能感到孤独，心流体验减少，满足感转向产品影响；角色边界模糊。

fiona.en: Planning should be just-in-time and lightweight; metrics like lines of code mislead; focus on outcomes.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中：规划应轻量且即时，代码行数等指标易误导，应关注结果而非产出。

fiona.en: Growing next-gen engineers requires apprenticeship models, not traditional paths; context switching load increases.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中：培养下一代工程师需学徒制而非传统路径；异步智能体增加上下文切换负担，需预留专注时间。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; specific abilities emerge unpredictably, but loss scales predictably. Alignment not guaranteed by scaling alone.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；具体能力不可预测地涌现，但损失可预测地缩放。对齐不能仅靠 Scaling 保证。

dario.en: Post-training becomes as important as pre-training; interpretability is nascent but crucial; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point.
dario.zh: 后训练变得与预训练同等重要；可解释性尚处萌芽但至关重要；AGI 是平滑指数曲线而非单一节点。

dario.en: AI progress is exponential; safety and capabilities intertwined; open source is a red herring; focus on actual capabilities, not AGI label.
dario.zh: AI 进步呈指数级；安全与能力交织；开源是伪命题；关注实际能力而非 AGI 标签。

dario.en: AI cognitive ability doubles every 4-12 months; will surpass humans in 1-2 years; enterprise adoption lags; wealth concentration and job disruption are key risks.
dario.zh: AI 认知能力每 4-12 个月翻倍；1-2 年内将超越人类；企业采用滞后；财富集中和就业冲击是关键风险。

dario.en: A 'country of geniuses' is more practical than superintelligence; alignment is like growing an organism; we are near the end of the exponential.
dario.zh: “天才之国”比超级智能更实际；对齐如同培育生物；我们正接近指数增长的终点。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，吴恩达认为教育应是基本人权，通过在线课程和同伴互评实现规模化精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress, while RL and AGI alignment are overhyped.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习推动进展，而强化学习和 AGI 对齐被过度炒作。

andrewng.en: Agentic workflows and open-weight models are already delivering value; energy and talent are key bottlenecks.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他认为智能体式工作流和开放权重模型已产生价值，能源和人才是关键瓶颈。

andrewng.en: AI skills are now essential for engineers; AGI is far off, and top-down workflow redesign yields more value.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年初，他提出 AI 技能对工程师至关重要，AGI 遥不可及，自上而下的工作流重构能带来更大价值。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL, with agentic workflows as key.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他称 AGI 是营销术语，缩放定律配方转向合成数据和强化学习，智能体式工作流成为关键。

andrewng.en: Coding agents advance fast; product management is the bottleneck; open-weight models trail frontier but useful.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他指出编程智能体进展迅速，产品管理成为瓶颈；开放权重模型落后前沿但实用。

ivyross.en: Design should address unarticulated needs; intuition complements data in design decisions.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足未言明的需求；直觉与数据互补，共同指导设计决策。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify humanity, not replace it.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；技术应增强人性，而非取代人性。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must foster conditions for creativity and play.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者必须为创造力和玩耍创造条件。

ivyross.en: Future work combines human creativity with AI, making creative skills more valuable.
ivyross.zh: 未来工作将人类创造力与 AI 结合，使创造性技能更有价值。

ivyross.en: Intuition and sensory experience are valid guides for decision-making, complementing rational analysis.
ivyross.zh: 直觉和感官体验是决策的有效指南，与理性分析互补。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; self-driving cars will dominate as insurance makes human driving costly.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入；自动驾驶将因保险成本而主导，人类驾驶会变得昂贵。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and boredom between career chapters fosters clarity; self-care and mentorship are key responsibilities.
fadell.zh: 在职业篇章之间休息和无聊能带来清晰；自我关怀和指导他人是重要责任。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define story; small teams thrive on self-management; climate solutions need investment.
fadell.zh: 从新闻稿开始定义故事；小团队靠自我管理；气候解决方案需要投资。

fadell.en: Great ideas are painkillers, not vitamins; v1 decisions are opinion-based; experts can hinder innovation.
fadell.zh: 好想法是止痛药而非维生素；初版决策基于观点；专家可能阻碍创新。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices are companions to smartphones; platforms are not businesses, apps capture value.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；未来设备是智能手机的伴侣；平台不是业务，应用捕获价值。

fadell.en: Start from customer pain; products need three generations; humans must stay in loop to avoid technical debt.
fadell.zh: 从客户痛点出发；产品需要三代迭代；人类必须参与以避免技术债。

fadell.en: Innovation comes from going off script; stay beginner to fix frictions; AI wearables will be federated, not one device.
fadell.zh: 创新来自打破常规；保持初学者心态修复摩擦；AI 可穿戴设备将是联邦式的，而非单一设备。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models. Current AI lacks common sense; scaling alone insufficient.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型。当前 AI 缺乏常识；仅靠 Scaling 不够。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is dark matter of intelligence; text alone insufficient for AGI; vision provides richer world info.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI；视觉提供更丰富的世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot achieve human-level intelligence; JEPA architectures and open source are key; AGI gradual.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 无法达到人类智能；JEPA 架构和开源是关键；AGI 是渐进过程。

lecun.en: LLMs less intelligent than a cat; world models enable reasoning/planning; human-level AI in 10 years; open source essential.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如猫聪明；世界模型实现推理/规划；十年内达到人类级 AI；开源至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are dead end; world models with JEPA and hierarchical planning; open research; robotics decade; objective-driven safety.
lecun.zh: LLM 是死胡同；世界模型结合 JEPA 和分层规划；开放研究；机器人十年；目标驱动安全。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch due to conservatism.
suleyman.zh: AI 进展因算力 Scaling（规模扩张）而可预测；谷歌在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is infinitesimally small; singularity is centuries away.
suleyman.zh: AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险微乎其微；奇点还有数百年之遥。

suleyman.en: AI systems should not claim consciousness; containment and alignment are crucial; AI companions can democratize expertise.
suleyman.zh: AI 系统不应声称有意识；遏制与对齐至关重要；AI 伴侣可普及专业知识。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; inference costs dropped 100x in two years.
suleyman.zh: 从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；推理成本两年内下降 100 倍。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near; Microsoft must own frontier models; white-collar tasks automated in 12-18 months, not jobs.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能临近；微软必须拥有前沿模型；白领任务将在 12-18 个月内自动化，而非整个岗位。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique human activities, not benchmark scores; private evals are key IP.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于赋能独特的人类活动，而非基准分数；私有评估是关键知识产权。

satya.en: Shift from per-user to consumption pricing; outcome-based pricing preferred until outcomes achieved.
satya.zh: 从按用户定价转向按消耗定价；基于结果的定价在结果实现前更受欢迎。

satya.en: In agentic world, generalists gain most; build agentic systems for Azure networking, not do it ourselves.
satya.zh: 在智能体式世界中，通才获益最大；为 Azure 网络构建智能体式系统，而非亲自去做。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；每家企业必须构建自己的爬山机器，以复利积累代币资本。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking via AI training; CEOs must understand token capital deeply.
satya.zh: 最大风险是通过 AI 训练泄露隐性知识；CEO 必须深刻理解代币资本。

murati.en: Scaling laws and iterative deployment with public feedback are key to alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她强调缩放定律和通过公开反馈的迭代部署是实现对齐的关键。

murati.en: Safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她主张安全工作应公开进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Shift from turn-based to time-based interaction models for real-time collaboration.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她转向强调基于时间的交互模型，而非轮次式，以实现实时协作。

murati.en: Humans must stay in the loop as long as possible for durable progress.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她认为应尽可能让人类参与其中，以实现持久进步。

murati.en: Governance and transparency matter more than individual character in AI development.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她指出在 AI 发展中，治理和透明度比个人品格更重要。

gustav.en: AI shifts internet from curation to generation; products must be rethought, with fault-tolerant UIs and VP-level autonomy.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 将互联网从策展推向生成，产品需重新设计，界面要对算法容错，自主权应放在副总裁层级。

gustav.en: Generative AI is an instrument enabling new creators; uniqueness becomes harder, not easier.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他反共识地提出生成式 AI 是乐器而非伪造，让新创作者和流派成为可能；但真正独特将更难。

gustav.en: Long tenure builds trust and efficiency; functional orgs work if leadership is stable, contrary to politics assumption.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他深化了组织观：长期任期建立信任与效率，职能型组织在稳定领导下可避免政治化，反共识。

gustav.en: Strategy is 'time well spent' over engagement; AI gives users control via plain English, not addiction.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他明确战略为“时间花得值”而非沉迷指标，AI 用自然语言赋予用户控制权，反共识地反成瘾。

gustav.en: Synchronized swimming beats divide-and-conquer for complex products; being first to adopt change is key.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他提出复杂产品应“花样游泳”而非分而治之，并在技术变革期率先采用变化是关键。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs and performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，他认为仅靠非正式模型扩展数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证是保证证明正确性和性能提升的关键。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is a major challenge.
carinahong.zh: 从 2026 年初到年中，他持续强调自动形式化比证明本身更难，尤其是在没有现成解的情况下正确形式化命题是重大挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains and sample efficiency.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，他将形式化验证视为“扩展才华”的手段，而非单纯纠错，并指出它能带来性能提升和样本效率。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary for open collaboration and progress.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，他坚持认为仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，形式化方法对于开放协作和进步不可或缺。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems; formal verification complements, not replaces.
carinahong.zh: 贯穿始终，他始终强调即便 AI 证明定理的能力超越人类，人类的品味和直觉依然关键，形式化验证是补充而非替代。

kaiser.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not slowing; pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models yield more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展是平滑的指数增长，并未放缓；预训练的缩放定律依然有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，后训练（如强化学习和合成数据）成为模型提升的主要驱动力；经济压力使焦点从规模扩张转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are 'jagged'—excellent in some areas, poor in nearby ones; generalization remains the key challenge, reasoning alone may not suffice.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我强调推理模型是“锯齿状”的——在某些领域出色，在邻近领域却表现不佳；泛化仍是关键挑战，仅靠推理可能不够。

kaiser.en: Reinforcement learning generalizes across domains but has jagged edges; coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x, enabling parallel work.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我认为强化学习能跨领域泛化，但存在锯齿边缘；编码智能体将研究者效率提升 5-10 倍，支持并行工作。

kaiser.en: Existential risk is not the main concern; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing; open source models persist for sovereignty reasons.
kaiser.zh: 始终，我认为生存风险不是主要担忧；系统入侵等近期风险更紧迫；开源模型因主权原因将持续存在。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's future is local and tool-integrated; scaffolding fades as models improve, but safety and labor impact need focus.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月：AI 的未来在于本地化与工具集成；随着模型改进，脚手架将弱化，但安全与劳动力影响需关注。

felixrieseberg.en: Shift from capability to adoption: biggest gap is people not realizing any problem can be given to AI; kids excel naturally.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：从能力转向应用：最大鸿沟是人们未意识到任何问题都可交给 AI；孩子天然擅长。

felixrieseberg.en: Embrace asynchronous, outcome-based interaction: don't supervise closely, judge by impact, and debug workflows with AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：拥抱异步、基于结果的交互：不密切监督，以影响评判，并用 AI 调试工作流。

mensch.en: Smaller models can be performant and cost-effective; data quality is critical; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年：小型模型也能高效且经济；数据质量至关重要；开源通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains and data quality are as important as compute; value shifts to applications; open source drives enterprise adoption.
mensch.zh: 2024 年：效率提升和数据质量与算力同等重要；价值转向应用层；开源推动企业采用。

mensch.en: AI is an opportunity, not a risk; sovereign AI requires control over data and infrastructure; AI augments jobs, not replaces.
mensch.zh: 2025 年：AI 是机遇而非风险；主权 AI 需掌控数据和基础设施；AI 增强而非取代工作。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation in applications; pre-training saturates; AGI is a direction, not a destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年：模型商品化，差异化在应用；预训练饱和；AGI 是方向而非终点。

mensch.en: Europe needs strategic autonomy; deep enterprise engagement differentiates; open source and local content are key.
mensch.zh: 2026 年：欧洲需战略自主；深度企业参与是差异化；开源和本地内容至关重要。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents.
danshipper.zh: AI 通过降低服务成本推动美国就业回流；AGI 的定义是智能体无限期自主运行的经济可行性。

danshipper.en: Agents become ubiquitous; humans remain essential for oversight and framing, debunking job apocalypse.
danshipper.zh: 智能体普及，但人类监督和任务界定仍不可或缺，驳斥了 AI 导致失业的末日论。

danshipper.en: Shift from CLI to GUI work surfaces like Codex and Claude Co-work; one super agent per company.
danshipper.zh: 工作界面从命令行转向 Codex 和 Claude Co-work 等图形界面；每家公司应有一个超级智能体。

danshipper.en: Consistent emphasis on human-AI collaboration, economic value, and non-coder empowerment.
danshipper.zh: 始终强调人机协作、经济价值和非程序员赋能。

jonyive.en: Design driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity must retain soul and joy.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他强调设计应由价值观和使命感驱动，而非利润；极简不应失去灵魂与乐趣。

jonyive.en: Innovation means moving forward, not breaking things; care and love in creation express gratitude.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，他提出创新是向前推进而非为破而破；用心制作是对人类的感恩。

jonyive.en: Tradition preserves fire, not ashes; EV enables new design possibilities, turning constraints into opportunities.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他主张传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬；电动化带来新设计可能，化限制为机遇。

jonyive.en: Authenticity in user experience; avoid fake engine sounds; physical controls over touchscreens for safety.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他强调用户体验的真实性，拒绝模拟声浪；出于安全，倾向物理按键而非触屏。

jonyive.en: Design must innovate; collaboration with outsiders enables disruption; performance is multidimensional.
jonyive.zh: 始终，他坚持设计必须创新，与外部合作促成颠覆；性能是多维的，不止于直线速度。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的不变核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进步需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是新的缩放轴，能提升推理能力并突破预训练限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是蓝海，在编码和数学之外潜力巨大。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size is the key lever for latency-cost tradeoff.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批处理大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length stagnation is due to memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度停滞源于内存墙。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays reduce data movement by local weight reuse.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导算力成本；脉动阵列通过局部权重复用减少数据移动。

reinerpope.en: Low precision yields quadratic efficiency gains: FP4 throughput is 3x FP8, not 2x, due to quadratic area scaling.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度带来二次方效率提升：FP4 吞吐量是 FP8 的 3 倍而非 2 倍，源于面积二次方缩放。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, not fundamentally different; deterministic latency in CPUs is possible but avoided.
reinerpope.zh: GPU 本质上是许多小 TPU 拼接而成，并无根本差异；CPU 确定性延迟可行但被市场回避。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant for fine-tuning; openness is crucial to prevent corporate capture and ensure safety as a system-level property.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，RLHF 仍是微调主流，开放性对防止企业垄断和确保安全作为系统级属性至关重要。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality beats algorithms; SFT gives 90% performance, DPO and RL add the rest, enabling open-source parity.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，后训练中数据质量胜过算法；SFT 提供 90%性能，DPO 和 RL 补充剩余，使开源模型能媲美前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and data contamination threaten reproducibility; open recipes are key.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，RLVR 是后训练最大突破，但过度优化和数据污染威胁可复现性；开放配方是关键。

lambert.en: Chinese open-weight models fill the US vacuum, driven by ideology and influence, not just business; they set industry standards.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，中国开源权重模型填补美国真空，受意识形态和影响力驱动，而非纯商业；它们设定了行业标准。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling persists but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling; open models lag 6-9 months.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，预训练缩放定律仍成立但低垂果实已尽；收益转向后训练和推理缩放；开源模型落后 6-9 个月。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning surpasses hand-coded stacks; modern tools make it interpretable, contrary to past beliefs.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈；现代工具使其可解释，与过去的看法相反。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns.
kendall.zh: 世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为，如在盲弯处缓慢前行。

kendall.en: Language integration enhances representation, human interaction, and introspection in driving models.
kendall.zh: 语言集成增强了驾驶模型中的表征、人机交互和内省能力。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible without prior training data, scaling via data and compute.
kendall.zh: 无需先验训练数据即可在 500 多个城市实现零样本泛化，通过数据和算力进行扩展。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithmic innovation; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis.
kendall.zh: 基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更关键；消费级车辆将超越机器人出租车。

jennywen.en: AI kills traditional design process; designers shift from research to rapid mockups, with time cut from 60-70% to 30-40%.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 3 月：AI 终结了传统设计流程，设计师从研究转向快速建模，建模时间占比从 60-70% 降至 30-40%。

jennywen.en: Design vision horizon shrinks from 2-5 years to 3-6 months; trust built via speed, shipping early, iterating fast.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 3 月：设计愿景周期从 2-5 年缩短至 3-6 个月；通过速度、尽早发布和快速迭代建立信任。

jennywen.en: Three designer archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads; taste insufficient, judgment key.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 5 月：出现三种设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家和“破解版”新毕业生；品味不够，判断力是关键。

jennywen.en: Designers control AI adoption; wait 6 months before new tools; focus on work and users, not hype.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 5 月：设计师掌控 AI 的采用；新工具等 6 个月再用；聚焦工作和用户，而非炒作。

jennywen.en: Persistent theme: designers must help engineers execute, not just hand off; speed and shipping are core value.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 3 月至 5 月：一贯主线：设计师必须帮助工程师执行，而非仅交付模型；速度和交付是核心价值。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、工艺和观点仍然至关重要；AI 输出是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas is superior to prompting for design adjustments; design becomes the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 画布上的直接操作优于提示调整；设计成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Leaders should build things themselves to inspire teams; visual-first design enables pull requests to production.
dylanfield.zh: 领导者应亲自构建以激励团队；视觉优先的设计使拉取请求直达生产成为可能。

dylanfield.en: Industry is at the start of AI integration; divergence-convergence loops are key for creativity.
dylanfield.zh: 行业处于 AI 整合的起步阶段；发散-收敛循环是创造力的关键。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；扩展推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: Iterative deployment and early governance are key to managing risks as AI capabilities grow.
pachocki.zh: 随着 AI 能力增长，迭代部署和早期治理是管理风险的关键。

pachocki.en: Continual learning via scaling pre-training and RL is the core goal; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现持续学习是核心目标；思维链监控有助于对齐。

pachocki.en: Alignment challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 对齐挑战集中在训练分布之外的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天。

pachocki.en: Biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中。

karpathy.en: Transformers are differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是可微分的计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会产生涌现能力，如上下文学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but must maintain entropy; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right; humanoid robots benefit from car transfer.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是关键但需保持熵；特斯拉端到端方法正确；人形机器人受益于汽车迁移学习。

karpathy.en: LLMs are like operating systems; Software 3.0 is prompting; agents need a decade, not a year, to mature.
karpathy.zh: LLM 类似操作系统；软件 3.0 是提示工程；智能体需要十年而非一年成熟。

karpathy.en: Pre-training is crappy evolution; RL is terrible; synthetic data collapses; we're summoning ghosts, not building animals.
karpathy.zh: 预训练是糟糕的进化；强化学习很糟糕；合成数据会崩溃；我们召唤的是鬼魂，而非构建动物。

karpathy.en: I haven't coded since December; agents do everything; bottleneck is directing them; agent-first tools are essential.
karpathy.zh: 自去年十二月起我不再写代码；智能体做所有事；瓶颈在于指挥它们；智能体优先的工具至关重要。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0 is prompting; context window is lever; jagged intelligence persists; understanding remains human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0 是提示工程；上下文窗口是杠杆；智能参差不齐；理解仍是人类瓶颈。

carlpei.en: Brand building is core, not afterthought; survival and consistency across touchpoints are key for startups.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年，强调品牌建设是核心而非事后考虑，生存和一致性是初创企业的关键。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in mature categories; tech should be fun to inspire human creativity.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，认为设计是成熟品类中最快的差异化手段，科技应有趣以激发人类创造力。

carlpei.en: AI shifts smartphones from app-based to intent-based; agents execute tasks, and apps may disappear.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，预测 AI 将智能手机从基于应用转向基于意图，智能体执行任务，应用可能消失。

carlpei.en: Smartphones won't be replaced by glasses; only brain-computer interfaces could kill them.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，认为智能手机不会被眼镜取代，只有脑机接口才能终结它。

carlpei.en: Marketing is arbitrage; find undervalued channels like short-form video for efficient growth.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，强调营销是套利，寻找被低估的渠道如短视频以实现高效增长。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他认为 Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能扩展的方法；反向传播并未解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: We should not control AI; let it develop permissionlessly. Safety via control is dangerous.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他主张不应控制 AI，而应让其无许可发展；通过控制来确保安全是危险的。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他强调强化学习是智能的核心，而下一个词预测缺乏实质性目标。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，仅从运行时经验学习。

sutton.en: Learning representations good for learning is the top open problem; RL is learning from experience.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他重申强化学习是从经验中学习，并指出学习“利于学习的表征”是首要未解问题。

kohli.en: AI in science should tackle root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，我认为 AI 在科学中应解决根本性问题，而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，我认为大语言模型的幻觉可与真值检测器结合，用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，我认为基于强化学习的后训练是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，我认为大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，我认为可解释性重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, requiring new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）至少还需十年以上，仅靠大语言模型可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress requires deep human evaluation, not leaderboard optimization.
edwinchen.zh: 像 Elo 这样的基准具有误导性且易被钻空子；真正的进步需要深度人工评估，而非排行榜优化。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, leading to differentiated AI models; eventually every company should train its own.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室在目标函数上存在分歧，导致 AI 模型差异化；最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI tools require human judgment; risks include anchoring, sycophancy, and omission, so safety must be prioritized.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 工具需要人类判断；风险包括锚定、谄媚和遗漏，因此必须优先考虑安全性。

turley.en: Model as product: iterate like software, ship daily, learn from real users; chat is not the end, UI will evolve.
turley.zh: 2025 年，强调模型即产品，要像软件一样快速迭代、每日发布，从真实用户反馈中学习；聊天不是终点，界面将演进。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous process for frontier models, but product development accelerated.
turley.zh: 2025 年，主张安全与产品速度分离：前沿模型需严格流程，但产品开发应最大化加速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 2026 年，北极星指标转向长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models transformative when productized.
turley.zh: 2026 年，认为下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、高交互产品；推理模型产品化后具有变革性。

turley.en: Pricing will evolve; unlimited plans may become unsustainable; curiosity is key skill to ask good questions.
turley.zh: 2026 年，指出定价将随技术变化，无限套餐可能难以为继；好奇心是提出好问题的关键技能。

nando.en: AI as a tool to extend human capabilities, learning from video and generalist agents like Gato are steps toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，认为 AI 是扩展人类能力的工具，从视频学习和像 Gato 这样的通用智能体是迈向 AGI 的步骤。

nando.en: AI safety is the biggest challenge; Africa leapfrogging legacy issues offers unique advantages in AI development.
nando.zh: 2026 年，强调 AI 安全是最大挑战；非洲通过跨越遗留问题在 AI 发展中具有独特优势。

nando.en: Emphasizes diversity and inclusion in AI community as essential for building beneficial technology.
nando.zh: 始终强调 AI 社区的多样性和包容性对于构建有益技术至关重要。

nando.en: Shift from focusing on scaling and generalist agents to prioritizing AI safety and responsible deployment.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年关注规模扩张和通用智能体，到 2026 年转向优先考虑 AI 安全和负责任部署。

nando.en: Believes fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, including Africa, and human skills like communication are key.
nando.zh: 始终相信基础创新可以来自任何地方，包括非洲，并且沟通等人际技能至关重要。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck; AI as creative partner; code as source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；将 AI 视为创意伙伴；代码为最终真相。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution with AI are most valuable; small teams outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 掌握端到端执行并善用 AI 的通才最有价值；小团队优于跨职能大组。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should show craft and intentionality, not process; side projects can outweigh experience.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应展示工艺与意图而非流程；副业项目可超越传统经验。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; ignoring it is like ignoring early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成常态；忽视它如同忽视早期互联网。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；通过更好的数据和算法，较小的模型也能超越较大的模型。

yejin.en: Post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety, but RLHF data is proprietary; open alternatives should be pursued.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 年到 2025 年，我持续强调后训练中的 RLHF（基于人类反馈的强化学习）对安全至关重要，但 RLHF 数据是专有的，应寻求开放替代方案。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我指出数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是内插人类知识，而非超越它。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning can be applied during pre-training to improve reasoning, despite computational cost.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我提出在预训练阶段引入强化学习可提升推理能力，尽管计算成本高昂。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; debiasing the internet is impossible, so embrace pluralism.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我主张多元对齐以尊重人类价值观的多样性；既然互联网去偏不可行，不如拥抱多元。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence and solving onboarding.
sholto.zh: 2024 年：长上下文窗口被低估；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能提升智能并解决上手问题。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with coding as leading indicator.
sholto.zh: 2025 年：强化学习成为新的扩展轴；预训练加强化学习或足以实现 AGI，编码是领先指标。

sholto.en: Agent reliability over time horizon is key; software engineering agents will soon handle junior-level tasks.
sholto.zh: 2025 年：智能体在时间跨度上的可靠性是关键；软件工程智能体很快能处理初级任务。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential; simple RL works best, and transformers are sufficient for AGI—no new architecture needed.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：进展是指数级的；简单强化学习效果最佳，Transformer 足以实现 AGI，无需新架构。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more; future work involves managing agent teams, not raw intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2026 年：能力过剩意味着工具和编排更重要；未来工作涉及管理智能体团队，而非原始智能。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over innovation.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，主张设计师应会编程以建立同理心并加速交付；优先追求速度与熟悉感，而非交互创新。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines are dynamic platforms.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，认为初创品牌策略应聚焦招聘与差异化；品牌指南是动态平台，而非僵化规则。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate its role in winning; brand storytelling attracts top talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，强调设计是战略武器，创始人需阐明其制胜作用；品牌叙事成为吸引顶尖人才的关键。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; avoid structured crits; favor organic feedback and gut decisions over data.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张招聘多元原型而非克隆；避免结构化评审，偏好有机反馈和直觉决策，而非数据驱动。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness trump perfection; give designers ownership and autonomy to grow and ship fast.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，强调速度与决断优于完美；赋予设计师所有权与自主权，以促进成长和快速交付。

brettaylor.en: AI agents will become the new app, with outcome-based pricing as the correct model.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月，认为 AI 智能体将成为新应用，基于结果的定价是正确的商业模式。

brettaylor.en: Software engineering shifts from writing code to operating AI code generators, requiring new languages prioritizing verifiability.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年中至 9 月，强调软件工程从编写代码转向操作 AI 代码生成器，需要优先可验证性的新语言。

brettaylor.en: AI agents will be compared to other agents, not humans, within a decade.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月，提出十年内 AI 智能体将与其他智能体比较，而非与人类比较。

brettaylor.en: Most enterprise incumbents will fail to transition to AI-native business models.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月，认为大多数企业级现有公司无法转型为 AI 原生商业模式。

brettaylor.en: AI should be a utility for learning, not addictive; generalists leveraging AI outperform narrow specialists.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月至 9 月，主张 AI 应作为学习工具而非成瘾品，利用 AI 的通才将胜过专才。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress; test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as next major driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年，认为缩放定律可预测进展，测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练缩放成为下一个主要驱动力。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation are better.
truell.zh: 2024 年，反共识观点：自然语言不会成为主要编程方式，示例和直接操作更优。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，编程从代码转向更高层意图说明，人类保持主导。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality; every magic moment in Cursor involves a custom model.
truell.zh: 2025 年，强调定制模型对产品质量至关重要，Cursor 中的每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

truell.en: AI shift more consequential than internet, unfolding over decades; taste and logic design skills become more valuable.
truell.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 变革比互联网影响更大，将持续数十年；品味和逻辑设计技能比细心更珍贵。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; empirical research is under-explored. Focus on skill building, not capability research. PhD is best path.
leike.zh: 2018 年：强调 AI 安全的重要性，认为实证研究不足，应专注技能培养而非能力研究，博士是成为安全研究者的最佳路径。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability. Alignment may be easier than thought; train deceptive models as 'model organisms'.
leike.zh: 2023 年：认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督和可解释性；对齐可能比想象中容易，可故意训练欺骗性模型作为“模式生物”来研究防御。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment dissolved. Post-training alone insufficient; need third-party testing and regulation.
leike.zh: 2024 年：批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，超级对齐团队解散；仅靠后训练不足以解决对齐问题，需要第三方测试和监管（如 SB 1047）。

shazeer.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction are AI-complete; scaling with compute and data yields intelligence, but internals remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为基于下一个词预测训练的 LLM 是 AI 完备的，Scaling（规模扩张）带来智能，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures enable efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年起，他强调推理时算力扩展和更长上下文窗口是近期机会，模块化稀疏架构（如专家混合）实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passive data; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他主张模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动数据；模块化持续学习可取代整体重训。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为测试时算力扩展推动进步但不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），智能体能力和强化学习至关重要。

shazeer.en: Open-source models are closing the gap with frontier models; AGI is underhyped economically, and coding is underhyped for self-acceleration.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他指出开源模型缩小与前沿模型的差距，AGI（通用人工智能）的经济影响被低估，编码对 AI 自我加速的作用也被低估。
